//! Pre-#477 metrics planner. The step is carried in whole seconds.

/// The caller-validated request window and step.
pub struct MetricsParams {
    /// The resolution, in whole seconds.
    pub step_s: i64,
}

/// The per-bucket exemplar ceiling.
pub const MAX_EXEMPLARS_PER_BUCKET: u32 = 100;
/// The per-bucket exemplar default.
pub const DEFAULT_EXEMPLARS_PER_BUCKET: u32 = 100;

pub fn axis_points(width: i64, step_s: i64) -> i64 {
    width / step_s
}
